purpose: INVENTED inputs for the FR-50 references' format sample: one case of each kind (K1, K2, K3, K4, K4h, E1, E2, E3, E4, E6) in spec/cases.json's schema, so that the writer runs on them and every output they give is marked invented. No value here is declared by protocol fr50-one-way-records-v1, and no output from them is a reference value of any registered case. The time rules, voltage counts and availability counts are the declared ones, so the outputs have the registered results' shape.

INVENTED_K1_neutral_zero_net.route: INVENTED: a neutral passive route on a patch, forward inward
INVENTED_K1_neutral_zero_net.requested: forward and backward fluxes, and the records F(t_i), B(t_i)

INVENTED_K2_neutral_relaxation.route: INVENTED: a neutral passive route on a patch, forward inward

INVENTED_K3_charged_kernel.route: INVENTED: a constant-field route of a charged species on a patch, forward inward
INVENTED_K3_charged_kernel.requested: forward and backward fluxes at each voltage, and their ratio

INVENTED_K4_transporter_equilibrium.route: INVENTED: the ATP-driven transporter at equilibrium
INVENTED_K4_transporter_equilibrium.requested: dG_cyc/(R T), J+ and J-, and the records F(t_i), B(t_i)

INVENTED_K4h_transporter_off_equilibrium.route: INVENTED: the same transporter off equilibrium
INVENTED_K4h_transporter_off_equilibrium.requested: dG_cyc/(R T), J+, J- and J-/J+

INVENTED_E1_membrane_route_at_reversal.route: INVENTED: a membrane route of a cation, forward outward, at V = E_K
INVENTED_E1_membrane_route_at_reversal.requested: E_K, the forward and backward fluxes, and the records

INVENTED_E2_junction_neutral.route: INVENTED: a junction route of a neutral species, equal concentrations

INVENTED_E3_face_uncharged.route: INVENTED: an uncharged face, equal concentrations

INVENTED_E4_blocked_channel_at_reversal.route: INVENTED: a blocked channel population, forward outward, at V = E_K
INVENTED_E4_blocked_channel_at_reversal.requested: E_K, u, the forward and backward fluxes, and the records

INVENTED_E6_blocked_channel_off_reversal.route: INVENTED: the same population at declared voltages off reversal
INVENTED_E6_blocked_channel_off_reversal.requested: u, the forward and backward fluxes, their ratio and their difference at each voltage and each availability

format: one JSON file per case, INVENTED_<case>.json, in the results layout
